name: Red — co-inoculated MLF (ML Prime)
desc: High-pH, low-acid reds. L. plantarum goes in 24 h after the yeast and finishes MLF in 3–10 days, during primary. Requires pH ≥3.4 at pitch — NO acid additions until malic is done.

additions.note: ~30 ppm. ML Prime tolerates 50 ppm total, so this is comfortable.
24 h after yeast pitch. No rehydration. Pack is sized for 66 gal — split across lots crushed the same day. Cannot multiply in wine, so do not under-dose.
At 1/3 sugar depletion. Organic N only — no DAP spikes.
HOLD until malic reads below 0.03 g/L. Bench-trial to target then. Adding at crush drops pH under 3.4 and kills this protocol.
Only after BOTH ferments test dry.

steps: Crush and destem with reduced SO₂ (~30 ppm).
Lallzyme EX, then Opti-Red. FT Rouge 8 h after the enzyme.
GATE: measure pH at 12–24 h. If below 3.4, stop and use the VP41 protocol instead. Do not acidify to fix pH — do not acidify at all yet.
Correct Brix only if needed. Leave pH and TA alone.
Rehydrate and inoculate the yeast with Go-Ferm Protect.
24 h later, once fermentation is clearly active: add ML Prime, dry, to the cap surface.
Hold 68–80°F through primary. Below 68°F ML Prime stalls; above 80°F it is stressed.
Do not blend, combine, or top fermenting lots after the bacteria go in.
Fermaid O at 1/3 sugar depletion. Avoid DAP entirely.
Cap management as usual. Press at dryness.
Test malic — expect it done by day 3–10. Hold all SO₂ until it reads below 0.03 g/L.
Now bench-trial tartaric and correct pH/TA. Then SO₂ to 30–35 ppm free and rack to aging.

name: Red — co-inoculated MLF (VP41)
desc: Default co-inoculation for high-Brix reds and any lot under pH 3.4. O. oeni tolerant to 16% alc, pH 3.1, 60 ppm total SO₂. Falls back to sequential if the co-inoc stalls, so it is the low-regret choice.

additions.note: ~38 ppm. VP41 tolerates 60 ppm total; keep under 45 ppm or hold ferment at 64–72°F.
Bench-trial to target. Safe at crush with VP41 (pH floor 3.1), but leave headroom — MLF will raise pH again.
1 g/hL. Rehydrate 15 min in 20× chlorine-free water at ~68°F, then add 24–48 h after yeast pitch.
At 1/3 sugar depletion. Organic N is gentler on co-inoculated MLB.
Only after BOTH ferments test dry.

steps: Crush and destem at ~38 ppm SO₂.
Lallzyme EX, then Opti-Red. FT Rouge 8 h after the enzyme.
Correct pH/TA/Brix at 12–24 h. Tartaric is fine here — target no lower than 3.3 so MLF has somewhere to go.
Rehydrate and inoculate the yeast with Go-Ferm Protect.
24–48 h later, once fermentation is clearly active: rehydrate VP41, add with Acti-ML.
Hold 64–72°F if potential alcohol is over 15.5% or total SO₂ is over 45 ppm; otherwise 68–77°F is fine.
Fermaid O at 1/3 sugar depletion. Avoid DAP spikes.
Cap management as usual. Press at dryness.
Test malic weekly. If it has not moved by day 14, press at dryness and let VP41 finish sequentially in barrel — it tolerates 16% and is the recommended strain for restarts.
Hold all SO₂ until malic reads below 0.03 g/L.
SO₂ to 30–35 ppm free, rack to aging.
